T-001.Title: Add the externalReload admission owner and rewrite the store entry points as thin adapters

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add src/renderer/src/util/externalReload.js with zero new dependencies and no store or component imports — every external effect is injected: read (ipcFs.read), schedule (timer placer receiving SETTLE_DELAY_MS), log, bus, isSamePath, buildSingleFileState (the existing getSingleFileState from store/help.js via injection from editor.js), recordPreReloadSnapshot and recordOpenedSnapshot (store/diffSnapshots.js recordSnapshot/recordOpenedSnapshot via injection). The module exports exactly the six locked anchors: RELOAD_PERMISSIONS ({ AUTOMATIC, CONFIRMED }), SETTLE_DELAY_MS = 100, decideAdmission({ permission, currentText, incomingText, hasPathname }) implementing the policy matrix in one boundary — AUTOMATIC plus equal text returns { action: 'skip' } with no replacement, no snapshot and no announcement, every other combination returns { action: 'replace', snapshot: hasPathname && currentText !== incomingText } so confirmed attempts replace even on equal text while no attempt ever adds an unequal-content snapshot beyond the single pre-reload record; buildReplacementManifest({ tab, pathname, data, buildSingleFileState }) producing the one explicit replacement manifest (fresh state from the injected builder with its new documentToken and fresh defaults, preserved filename/format metadata from ready data, incomingMarkdown, preReloadMarkdown, oldId, oldNotifications, the eligible non-unified oldHistory capture { stack: [current], index: 0 } or null, savedCursor/savedScrollTop/savedMuyaIndexCursor, splitSession retirement, blocks drop, mixedLineEndings flag, snapshotRequired); commitReplacement(manifest, { store, deps }) as the strictly synchronous commit stage in the exact current loadChange order — pre-reload snapshot when snapshotRequired, oldHistory pop, Object.assign of the fresh state, oldId/oldNotifications/cursor/scrollTop/muyaIndexCursor restoration, splitSession delete and tab.blocks = undefined, recordOpenedSnapshot, history restore, mixed-line-ending tab notification, tab.contentReloaded = true, and the current-tab announcement (store.currentFile = tab; bus emit file-changed with id/markdown/muyaIndexCursor/cursor/renderCursor: true/history/scrollTop/contentReloaded: true and no blocks field); readWithSettle({ pathname, attempt, deps }) as the one read/settle mechanism — one schedule(SETTLE_DELAY_MS) settle, attempt.isLive() revalidation before the await and after the read, returning markdown or null on staleness/failure with no retries and no queue; and createExternalReloadController(deps) returning handleFileChange({ type, change, tab, store, attempt }), applyLoadedChange({ change, store }) and the conflict-notification factory whose action is truthy-status, generation-bound through attempt.isLive() and consumed exactly once (a declined or stale call never consumes it). handleFileChange carries the permission kind (AUTOMATIC only when the tab isSaved clean tab passed the store's autoSave/liveReload/previewMode/watchMode gate, CONFIRMED only through the notification action), revalidates liveness before and after every await, re-enters the current conflict resolution through store.APPLY_FILE_CHANGE(type, change) when local markdown/revision drift is found during settle or read (automatic: !tab.isSaved || attempt.localContentChanged(); confirmed: drift against the markdown/revision captured at the choice), preserves the exact log markers BLOCK_LIVE_RELOAD (source=data|disk), BLOCK_RELOAD_SKIPPED (reason=hash-match, disk path only), BLOCK_RELOAD_CONFLICT (reason=dirty-tab) and BLOCK_READ_FAILED, applies nothing on read failure (no replacement, no snapshot, no automatic retry), and never lets an await split the final admission decision from the synchronous commitReplacement call.
